description: This file defines a class 'populateSeedData' responsible for generating and populating seed data for tracking modules within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes logic for creating random monitor data entries, managing session IDs, and interacting with database and TrackerManager instances, primarily for testing or data seeding purposes.

classes.name: populateSeedData
classes.description: A class responsible for generating seed tracking data for modules. It manages database connections, user demo data, and tracker monitors to simulate user actions across various modules for testing or seeding purposes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes database connection, loads user demo data, and populates tracker monitors with randomized data across specified modules.

methods.name: populate_tracker
methods.description: Populates a tracker monitor object with data such as user ID, module name, action, visibility, timestamp, session ID, and item ID.

methods.name: randomTimestamp
methods.description: Generates a random timestamp between Feb 1, 2008 and the current time.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a session ID for a user, ensuring consistent session assignment during data generation.
